annotations.text:
Tap Working / Hiring. The pill slides, but the point is everything behind it: page ground, hero gradient, bell, badges and the cards all re-theme at once.

The artboard has two levers above it — curve and duration — so you can dial the feel without me republishing.

What the reference actually does: each tab owns a whole theme (Dineout violet, Scenes black, Instamart white, Food green) and the entire surface — background, search field, placeholder text — changes with it.

One caveat: the swap completes inside a single frame of that recording, so I could not measure its easing. These four are honest candidates, not a match.
Today the toggle has no moving part at all — HomeShift.jsx just swaps text colour between #fff and rgba(255,255,255,0.55). There is nothing to animate yet, which is why it feels dead.
